about: T-564 (the boot screens' last pieces, DRAFTS): today's boot filmed from reset to the title on the DEBUG ROM -- the copyright screen, the CodeMusic splash (the band, the flying star, the binary-and-notes glints, the wordmark and the ring), the thank-you card, then the title's reveal and its run, with a fine burst for the slash's sweep across the logo (it first crosses 540 frames into the run). The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved.
